changes: Retain three GPIO resets, factory identity load and default touch mode.
Reconcile native always-on PM8150B GPIO5: require exact observed PMIC/GPIO profile, EE0 write ownership, enable only C444 bit7; wait4000us and re-read full profile. Already-high path does not write.
Map only the selected APID write page; no ownership changes, voltage/mux changes, retries or power-off. Retain rail on touch failure as native always-on.
Log enable result, write attempts, before/after latch, APID/owner/channel and readback; keep5s rail capture and raw/FIFO/HID evidence. Replace redundant30s C1 capture, unchanged trace capacity.
limitations: PM8150B GPIO5 output-low in79 is a proven board configuration difference; its physical connection to FTS AVDD and touch causality remain unproven.
No analog voltage measurement. Enabling the board rail does not by itself prove working touch.
No QEMU, NVM writes, voltage programming or Data/Recovery formatting.
